A quick look at farewell routines in detail
An efficient run is easier when you know what to expect
Companion Animal Travel Desk: large dog travel basics

If you are checking in a large dog with Aurelia Skyways, keep the paperwork clean, the carrier ready, and the handoff simple. The Companion Animal Travel Desk works from booking through pickup, so the goal is steady care and no surprises.

Bring the health certificate and any required travel notes to the counter. <<FACT F081>> The welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs, checks the carrier fit, and makes sure the handoff plan matches the trip. If something looks off, speak up right away so we can sort it before boarding.

Age matters too. <<FACT F075>> If your dog is not ready, the safest move is to wait and rebook when the trip fits the animal better. That keeps stress down and avoids last-minute refusals.

On the day of travel, keep food and water guidance followed exactly as given in your booking notes. Use a secure carrier, leave loose items out, and label the crate clearly. If your pet gets restless, stay calm and follow staff directions. The cabin team watches animals during flight, and supervisors step in when a passenger is worried.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you arrive at the airport.
